about_the_game:
Become a cosmic god and control empires at will in epic, short battles. This is a real-time strategy game. Lead uncommon factions like ants, dwarves, and skeletons, each with their own units, tech paths, and counters. Customize the look and playstyle of your empire, and show your mastery in fast, epic battles where reading the terrain, choosing counters, and timing your counterattacks wins wars.

Face a full campaign that explores the rise of each empire. Pursue weekly goals in rotating co-op and solo challenges. Create custom match tables (private lobbies with rules) to fight other gods on your terms. Earn cosmetics to show off your style in all modes and unlock Battle Modifiers that remix campaign levels.

Master your empire. Rewrite the battlefield. Surpass the pantheon.

Features

  • RTS by design: Base building, economy, and army control (macro and micro) in fast, epic battles.

  • Uncommon empires: Ant legions, dwarves, skeletons, and more, each with unique tactics.

  • Deep customization: Adjust visuals and playstyle with unlockable cosmetics and build-defining choices.

  • Weekly challenges: Co-op and solo objectives that refresh regularly to offer new challenges, perks, and prestige.

  • Custom match tables: Host private lobbies with your rules to face friends and rivals.

  • Story campaign: Live each empire’s story and remix chapters with Story Modifiers (campaign-only).

  • Fast, epic battles: Snappy flow with balanced counters—spears stop cavalry, archers punish slow troops, and siege brings down walls.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4310M / i5-4300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 8GB of system memory required

short_description: Become a cosmic god commanding uncommon empires ants, dwarves, skeletons, and more. Conquer weekly co-op challenges, Conquer roguelike runs, live each empire’s story, and prove to the other gods that you’re the best through strategy and precise control in epic battles!
supported_languages: English, Italian, Spanish - Latin America, Russian
